app.name: Tiens Bon
app.tagline: A local-first companion to help you quit smoking at home, in your own voice and with total privacy.

craving.holdOn: Hold on, 3 minutes to catch your breath
craving.congrats: Well done! One more craving overcome.
craving.heldSuccess: Well done! You let this wave pass. This is a real victory.

relapse.title: Breathe, no guilt
relapse.subtitle: Every step is part of learning.
relapse.message: A slip does not erase everything you achieved. By observing what happened, we move forward.
relapse.step2Title: 2. What did you miss to hold on?
relapse.step3Title: 3. What would you like to adjust next time?
relapse.planIfPlaceholder: Ex: If I have a morning coffee...
relapse.planThenPlaceholder: Ex: Then I drink a big glass of water on the terrace...

missing.time: A little more time to catch my breath
missing.support: A trusted friend to talk to
missing.place: Being able to change rooms or location

pregen.title: Prepare my day (Offline cache)
pregen.desc: Pregenerates 12 personalized messages (morning, risk windows, cravings, evening) for 100% offline availability with zero latency.
pregen.success: Day ready! 12 messages in local cache ready for today.

profile.title: My personal profile
profile.alternatives: What I like to do instead
profile.userSubtitle: Your personalized space, your phrases and your motivations to hold on.

demo.description: Fictional local data to test the application.
demo.bundledBanner: These messages were generated locally by Gemma and bundled for this demo.

model.title: Local Gemma Model Connection
model.statusOk: Ollama is connected and Gemma 2:2b is ready.
model.statusMissing: Ollama is online, but gemma2:2b model is missing. Run: ollama pull gemma2:2b
model.statusUnreachable: Cannot reach Ollama. Check that Ollama is running on 127.0.0.1:11434.

distress.message: You are not alone. If you are going through an intense moment of distress, these caring people and professionals are here for you:

safety.filtered: The message was safely adjusted to remain 100% gentle and free of reproach.

backup.title: Encrypted Backup (Web Crypto)
backup.description: Your data never leaves your device unencrypted. The export is sealed in AES-GCM 256-bit with HMAC signature.

disclaimer.medical: This application is not medical advice and does not provide medical services.
disclaimer.doctor: If you need medical advice, please consult a pharmacist or doctor.

gallery.title: My resource photos
gallery.subtitle: Calming photos, motivations or goals. GPS and camera metadata are automatically removed.
gallery.captionPlaceholder: E.g.: That sunset by the sea that brought so much peace...
gallery.lovedOneLabel: This photo represents a loved one
gallery.lovedOneNote: Kindness rule: will never be shown after a slip or relapse.
gallery.reEncodedNotice: Photo re-encoded locally via Canvas (no GPS metadata preserved).

selftalk.title: Messages to my future self
selftalk.subtitle: Written in a calm moment, replayed during a craving to remind you who you are.
selftalk.addMessage: Write a message to my future self
selftalk.placeholder: E.g.: Remember why you started. This craving is just a wave...
selftalk.saved: Message saved for your future craving moments.

reminders.title: Reminders before risk moments
reminders.subtitle: Automatically scheduled {leadTime} minutes before each risk window with your chosen alternative.
reminders.discreetModeOn: Enabled: neutral text shown on lock screen. Nothing about smoking is revealed.
reminders.discreetModeOff: Disabled: displays your personalized message and chosen alternative directly.
reminders.testDenied: Notifications are blocked or disabled in this browser.
reminders.planBTitle: Plan B: Native phone clock alarms
reminders.planBSubtitle: If your PC or connection is unavailable, set these alarms in your phone's native clock app:
reminders.noWindows: No risk windows defined in profile.

checkin.title: Evening check-in (2 min)
checkin.subtitle: A moment to lay down your day in free text. The AI extracts key themes without ever judging you, and you maintain complete control over what is saved.
checkin.promptPlaceholder: Freely describe your day... What moments were easy? Were there temptations, a hard coffee, or stress? Did you hold on or smoke?
checkin.reviewTitle: What the AI extracted (you can edit anything):
checkin.distressMsg: We detected distress in your message. Your helpline and trusted support contact are top priority.

recap.title: Weekly recap & learned patterns
recap.subtitle: Your aggregated victories, savings to date, and observed risk windows.
recap.noTriggers: No dominant triggers identified this week.

audio.unsupported: Speech synthesis not supported on this browser.

wearable.title: Smartwatch & wearable trigger
wearable.subtitle: Instantly launch your craving session from a watch button (Apple Watch, Wear OS, Samsung Bixby) or an NFC tag.
wearable.instruction1: Samsung Galaxy Watch: create a Bixby Routine sending a GET request to this URL.
wearable.instruction2: Apple Watch: use iOS Shortcuts app with 'Get Contents of URL' and add to watch face complications.
wearable.instruction3: Android / Wear OS: configure Tasker or HTTP Shortcuts widget.

facts.title: Sourced health facts (WHO & Public Health)
facts.subtitle: Hand-written from official health authorities. Never generated or reworded by the AI model.

pinLock.title: Optional App PIN Lock (Web Crypto)
pinLock.subtitle: Protects app access from casual snooping using PBKDF2 + AES-GCM.
pinLock.honestNote: Transparency note: this PIN blocks casual snooping if someone picks up your unlocked phone, but does not replace Android's device screen lock and disk encryption against a determined attacker.
pinLock.warningForgotten: Important: if you forget your PIN, your data cannot be recovered. Export a backup before turning it on.
pinLock.unlockSubtitle: Enter your personal PIN to unlock Tiens Bon.
pinLock.forgotResetPrompt: Forgot PIN? Reset and delete all data

welcome.title: Welcome to Tiens Bon
welcome.subtitle: Your local, compassionate companion to quit smoking at your own pace.
welcome.namePlaceholder: Your first name or nickname (e.g. Alex, Sam...)
welcome.nameRequired: Please enter your name to continue.
welcome.privacyNote: Your data remains 100% private and stored only on this device.

deleteAll.title: Data Control & Delete Everything
deleteAll.desc: Permanently deletes your profile, journal, photos, cached messages, and local settings from this device.
deleteAll.confirmPrompt: Are you sure you want to permanently erase all local data? This cannot be undone.
deleteAll.deletedSuccess: All local data and caches have been erased.

game1010.title: 1010 Puzzle — Keep Hands Busy
game1010.subtitle: Inspired by the open-source 1010! game (Prinzhorn): place the 3 shapes on the grid to clear full rows or columns, with zero time pressure.
game1010.selectPieceHint: 1. Tap a shape below then 2. Tap a grid cell to place it.
game1010.zenAutoCleared: Zen Mode: 3 lines gently cleared so you can keep playing stress-free.
game1010.gameOverTitle: No more moves on the board
game1010.gameOverDesc: Great focus! Start a fresh board or clear 3 lines to continue.
